goal: Close the owner sign-out dead end, the Telegram blank-username deep-link divergence, the two self-contradicting DB fan-outs, and the duplicated auto-approval threshold labels, per PR 1 of the portal audit remediation spec.

Unifying the admin and owner channel route chains — that is PR 2
Collapsing the two AutoApprovalReadinessBlockReason maps — deliberately different registers
Sequentialising the three fixed-width fan-outs in spec section 3.6 — comment only
Adding any new env var, feature flag, or dependency
